final: WITH site_avgs AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat, AVG(m.facetfaces) AS avg_faces FROM sites s JOIN scanmesh m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(m.facetfaces) AS avg_faces FROM sites s JOIN scanmesh m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry), status_avgs AS (SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_faces) AS avg_faces FROM site_avgs WHERE entrystat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY entrystat), kept AS (SELECT a.avg_faces, b.avg_faces AS baseline_faces, st.avg_faces AS status_faces FROM site_avgs a CROSS JOIN baseline b JOIN status_avgs st ON st.entrystat = a.entrystat WHERE a.entrystat IS NOT NULL AND a.avg_faces > st.avg_faces) SELECT AVG(avg_faces), AVG(avg_faces - baseline_faces), AVG(avg_faces - status_faces) FROM kept
